fields.name: scheduleId
fields.mapping: static-config — the stable key used throughout the rest of the model

fields.name: timeRange
fields.mapping: static-config — empty for presets with no fixed hours (Any Time, Waking Hours)

meta.description: The lookup table for schedule presets — currently static reference data (not built from any event), same pattern as ProjectColourPaletteView. 'scheduleId' is the stable key stored on CreateProject/ProjectCreated; 'name' and 'timeRange' are display-only, resolved here. FUTURE: once custom schedules are supported, this stops being static config and becomes a real event-sourced read model (folding e.g. ScheduleCreated/ScheduleUpdated), and 'scheduleId' starts referencing user-created schedules instead of only these 6 fixed presets — CreateProject.scheduleId and ProjectCreated.scheduleId will not need to change shape when that happens, only this lookup's source.
